eyebrow: Policy bound to the file, not the storage account
code:
label: "Highly Restricted"
encryption: rights-managed
decrypt_if:
  identity.verified == true
  AND device.compliant == true
  AND location in ["corp-managed"]
// evaluated at the moment of open —
// on a laptop, in an inbox, anywhere
caption: The decryption key enforces policy wherever the file ends up, not just inside your storage account.
